notes.title: Summer Bug Fix Update
notes.notes: [p]Fellow Resonators,[/p][p][/p][p]a preliminary update for the Windows version (V6.5) is posted to Steam, fixing a slew of issues that people have reported:[/p][list][*][p]No more infinite loop at the end of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Tunnels are now integrated into the sound settings[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mouse should be less weird when Alt-Tab-ing[/p][/*][*][p]re-encoding of all videos[/p][/*][*][p]move to Unity 6 renderer[/p][/*][/list][p]Versions for the other operating systems will follow soon.[/p][p]Thanks so much for all the feedback! We still have another Updated coming in the fall - with a demo and some story tie-in for our next game, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: a permanent echo
notes.notes: [p]Fellow Resonators![/p][p]Have you wondered how the world transformed to the setting to Mini Mini Golf Golf? [/p][p]We certainly have, and we have been hard at work ideating, prototyping and designing the next project in our setting of Neo Baltica.[/p][p]We are super-proud to present the Announcement Trailer for our next game - a permanent echo![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WfmU6m0gs5g;full"][/previewyoutube][p]a game about investigation and deduction. About piecing together how we will remember - and judge - the decisions that shape our future.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are curious what the new game is about, head on over to its [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727200/a_permanent_echo/"]brand new steam page[/url] and let us know your thoughts in our [url="https://discord.gg/h9PrjMAP" style="text"]Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We are still working on a demo for Mini Mini Golf Golf that should release this summer, and that will tie together both games and offer some more content-surprises![/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Neo Baltica
notes.notes: [p]Fellow Resonators,[/p][p][/p][p]we are incredibly excited to finally share the common thread that ties our projects (this one, but also the coming one) together.[/p][p]Enter [url="https://neobaltica.com"]neobaltica.com[/url] - a one stop shop for our speculation of a european future and the transformations that are to come.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182888/6f3ce85b9fc49de2eb6214be468bf5bfb78b7eab.png"][/img][/p][p]And if you look closely, somewhere past the timeline, you'll find a link to our next project, and a place to participate in the last steps of a little ARG that we ran with our [url="https://discord.gg/N9ubwYay"]Discord [/url]and [url="https://www.instagram.com/stories/highlights/18032661644341053/"]Instagram [/url]community these past couple of weeks.[/p][p]We can't wait to tell you all about what's next! See you on the other side![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Award Nomination and Glitch Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators.

we are ✨incredibly✨ excited to be nominated for "Best Story" for this year's Deutscher Computerspielepreis (German Videogames Award): 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182888/fecdc2f9c24fa76b9723d570e94eafffe8116a7d.png[/img]

Since this is our first game, and it's all funded with our own money, this is obviously huge for us.

But there's more good news! One of the few thoughtfully worded complaints from the reviews mentions a certain amount of frustration building up over the course of finishing the game.
Today's update is hopefully addressing some of those concerns by removing the complete restart of longer glitch courses when the ball falls out of bounds. Instead, you can now continue from the last blocker you hit. 
This change is valid for all difficulty levels from Version 6.0.

Thank you so much to everyone who has reached out via our Discord, on our socials or by writing your thoughts here on Steam on the forums or as a review. It means the world to us.

And we have still more exciting new things in store for you these coming weeks!
Take care!

notes.title: Spring Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

after much rewiring under the hood, we are happy to finally bring you full Gamepad Support for Version 5.0!
Stay tuned in the coming weeks as we have a number of super exciting announcements to make!

Thanks, as always, to our Discord and Steam community for all Feedback and thoughts!

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

we're excited to bring you the first major feature update of the year - playstyle customization in the form of three difficulty adjustments:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182888/a0b40d197d5463672f98ef675250a487b45eb401.gif[/img]

They don't fundamentally change the game, but they allow the game to cater to a more varied mix of playstyles - those that are mainly interested in the story, those that like to add deducing hints from separate media, and those that enjoy a bit more of a mini-golfing challenge on top.
It's possible to change your preference anytime during your playthrough.

As always, our Discord and Steam Discussion boards are open for your Input and we are eager to adjust things along the way.

Stay tuned, there will be more! We have some exciting things coming from the studio throughout this year, all tied in to Mini Mini Golf Golf.

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

thanks to your Feedback, we were able to identify a number of small and enormous (when it came to some of the subtitles on the Mini Mini Talk Talk episodes) text based kerfuffles and are happy to report that they are all fixed now.

* fixed subtitles in MiniMiniTalkTalk episode 3
* fixed subtitles in MiniMiniTalkTalk episode 6
* fixed typo in "Breakup"
* fixed PDA not showing final segment 
* fixed rare edge case of ball getting stuck on course boundary when jumping out of hole again.

Plus: A workaround for those affected by Steam Deck Issues:
If you installed the game on Steam Deck prior to the 3.2. patch, a typo in the Steam Cloud configuration has led to a catastrophic problem with save game folder file names. 
[b]Fortunately, things can be fixed by deleting the game's save game folder from Home/.config/unity3d/ThreeMoreYears[/b] (just remove that ThreeMoreYears folder), or just renaming the folder within from MIniMiniGolfGolf to MiniMiniGolfGolf.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this typo!

Thanks again to everyone who took some time out of their day to report a bug or two.
Happy resonating!

notes.title: Post Release Update 2
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

we have made another post-release adjustment from your Feedback:

Zoe will now help you with unlocking resonant tunnels if you are struggling.
If you tried for more than three rounds but didn't get the unlock, she will spawn a button to hack the glitch through code.

We hope this takes away Frustration and leads to a more smooth gameplay experience.

Along with this update come some fixes:
* no longer getting stuck between the Screens and the PDA, 
* cleaned up some illegible text 
* moved Videos out of Addressables for (hopefully) faster playback

new Version number is now 3.0

Again, thank you for your Feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators!

[previewyoutube=-lM485mcCiw;full][/previewyoutube]

First of all, thank you all so much for showing up at Next Level Festival and Games Ground these past couple of days. So many of you played our game and we got so much positive feedback, it really warms our hearts!

We want to make sure that you all are getting an experience that is worthy of your appreciation so far - and for that we want to take a little longer to work on our game.

So we have decided to push our release date to 12.12.24.

We are so excited to get the full game into your hands as soon as possible, and we feel these extra weeks will give us the opportunity to be less stressed and more coordinated in our launch, resulting in a better experience for you, our players.

We have many things we want to talk to you about in these coming weeks, so stay tuned for more updates.

Three More Years Team
